description: A clear plastic tube with a red lid sits on a pink surface in front of a white backdrop, with a dark shirt lying to the right. The left hand holds the tube steady while the right hand twists and lifts off the red lid, then grabs the shirt and stuffs it down into the open tube, pressing it in; the right hand briefly withdraws and brings the red lid back toward the tube opening while the left hand continues supporting the tube as a left-hand object.
